releases.title: Releases
releases.intro: Create named editions from pinned question revisions. Frozen content stays unchanged when the bank changes.
releases.label: Edition name (required)
releases.visibility: Questions and edition history are visible to workspace members with content access. Check workspace membership before publishing.
releases.grantRequired: An administrator must explicitly grant you “Can publish editions” in member settings. Workspace ownership alone does not grant publication permission.
releases.refreshHelp: Refresh current selections to their latest revisions and reload review evidence and collection names. Explicit historical selections stay pinned. The selected question set stays the same.
releases.correction: Changes requested — resolve, exclude, or explain an override before freezing.
releases.prepareHelp: Retain the selected QTI and uploaded media before confirming the edition. Missing or unsupported media blocks preparation.
releases.freezeHelp: Freeze all {count} selected revisions. This confirmation covers the entire edition, including pages you have not opened.
releases.attestAll: I attest all {count} selected revisions requiring publisher attestation for this edition.
releases.override: Reason to override this changes-requested review (required)
releases.destinationGate: This archive retains the frozen source questions and assets. Use a destination package for LMS import.
releases.withdrawHelp: Withdrawal blocks new downloads. It cannot recall copies already downloaded. The frozen content and evidence remain unchanged.
releases.selectionHelp: Questions shared by selected collections appear once, in collection order. You can also select questions in the bank.
releases.metadataChanged: Edition name, notes, or collection labels changed
releases.error.invalid_input: Check the edition form and try again.
releases.error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this edition operation.
releases.error.label_exists: Choose a different edition name. This workspace already has that name.
releases.error.operation_conflict: This confirmation belongs to a different operation. Reload the edition.
releases.error.stale_preview: The draft or its selected revisions changed. Reload the preview and confirm the selection again.
releases.error.invalid_selection: Choose between 1 and 1,000 available questions from this workspace.
releases.error.frozen: This edition is frozen. Create another edition to change its content.
releases.error.not_frozen: Freeze the edition before using this operation.
releases.error.withdrawn: This edition is withdrawn. New downloads are blocked.
releases.error.preparation_required: Prepare the retained source before freezing.
releases.error.preparation_conflict: This preparation is no longer available. Reload the edition.
releases.error.storage_failed: The retained source could not be stored or retrieved. Try again.
releases.error.technical_blocker: Required content or media is missing or unsupported. Resolve it before freezing.
releases.error.attestation_required: Explicitly attest the complete selected revision set with a reason.
releases.error.override_required: Explain why this edition includes revisions with changes requested.
releases.selfAttested: Publisher attested · Also authored this revision
releases.excludeExceptions: Exclude all {count} revisions with changes requested
releases.overrideRecorded: Changes-requested override recorded for this edition
releases.error.manifest_changed: The manifest changed. Reload the edition.
releases.error.wrong_revision_set: The confirmation does not cover the required revisions.
releases.error.invalid_transition: The edition already has this availability state. Reload it.
releases.package.title: Destination packages
releases.package.scope: Exports supported single-choice questions with 0/1 scoring in their original language. Optional formatting is simplified and choices use their saved order. Any excluded questions are listed before download.
releases.package.manual: Import the downloaded XML in Sakai: Tests & Quizzes → Question Pools → Import Pool → Export from this (or other Sakai) system. Generated means the file is ready; verify the imported pool and scoring in your destination.
releases.package.blocked: No usable pool could be produced. Review the questions listed below and prepare a corrected edition.
releases.package.flatPool: Collection labels are retained in the edition. Sakai imports one flat pool without chapter subpools.
releases.package.confirm: I accept these warnings for this exact package and destination policy.
releases.package.dispatchPending: The build is queued, but Workflow dispatch could not finish. Reload the edition to check progress.
releases.package.partialSummary: This pool includes {included} questions and excludes {excluded}. The complete edition stays unchanged.
releases.package.presentationSimplified: Optional text formatting is omitted. Question and answer text are preserved.
releases.package.fixedChoiceOrder: Choices use their saved order instead of shuffling.
releases.package.questionsExcluded: The receipt lists every excluded question and the reason it was excluded.
releases.package.essentialContent: This question needs media or content that this pool format cannot retain. It remains in the complete edition.
releases.package.invalidXml: The question XML needs repair. Correct it and prepare a new edition.
releases.package.sourceRepair: The retained source package needs repair. Prepare a new edition from the original questions.
releases.package.unsupportedQuestion: This question uses an interaction or scoring rule that this pool format cannot retain. It remains in the complete edition.
